summary: Burke's Bus Service - A pre-trip checklist app for 28-ft box trucks with public access for drivers and admin dashboard for tracking submissions
architectural_notes: Public checklist access requires no authentication for regular users
Admin authentication uses Internet Identity for Brent Berkemeier and Wendell
Checklist progress stored in local browser storage (localStorage)
Completed checklist submissions stored server-side anonymously
Mobile-first responsive design for field use

existing_features.title: Create a public-access pre-trip checklist form for a 28-ft box truck with 7 sections: Documents & Cab (18 items), Engine Compartment (9 items), Tires & Wheels (6 items), Brakes & Suspension (6 items), Lights & Electrical (7 items), Box/Cargo Area (7 items), Safety & Emergency (5 items), Final Walk-Around (5 items), and Driver Acknowledgment (2 items). Each item must be a checkbox with the exact labels provided in the pre-checklist.
Add a submit button to the checklist form that sends the completed checklist to the backend for storage. After successful submission, clear the local browser storage and show a confirmation message.
Create an admin dashboard accessible only through Internet Identity authentication. The dashboard should be accessible to specific principals for Brent Berkemeier and Wendell.

Build an admin view that displays all submitted checklists in a table or list format. Include submission timestamps, completion status summary, and the ability to view full details of each checklist submission.
Ensure the entire application (public checklist and admin dashboard) is fully responsive and works seamlessly on mobile devices (iOS and Android) as well as desktop browsers.

Design a professional, clean visual theme for Burke's Bus Service that conveys reliability and safety. Use a color palette and typography that reflects the transportation/logistics industry, and apply this theme consistently across both the public checklist and admin dashboard.

new_feature_requests.summary: Public pre-trip checklist with 7 sections (Documents & Cab, Engine Compartment, Tires & Wheels, Brakes & Suspension, Lights & Electrical, Box/Cargo Area, Safety & Emergency, Final Walk-Around, Driver Acknowledgment)
Local browser storage for checklist progress while users work on it
Anonymous submission and server-side storage of completed checklists
Admin dashboard with Internet Identity login for Brent Berkemeier and Wendell to view and track all submitted checklists with timestamps
Implement local browser storage to save checklist progress while users are working on it, so they don't lose their progress if they navigate away or refresh the page before submitting.
Create a backend endpoint to accept and store completed pre-trip checklist submissions anonymously. Store all checkbox states, submission timestamp, and any driver acknowledgment information.
